data.name: Essaeed
data.gender_notes: Essaeed is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that signifies a person who is worthy of praise and admiration. The name Essaeed carries the meaning “Praiseworthy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Essaeed usually hope their child will grow to embody praiseworthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reflects the qualities of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
data.etymology: Essaeed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praiseworthy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Essaeed total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: السعيد
in_arabic.meaning: السعيد يعني الفرحان المسرور بالخير الكثير
in_arabic.long_meaning: السعيد هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الفرحان المسرور بالخير الكثير، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'والسَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِيَ وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ * إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ فِرْدَوْسًا * إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ هُمُ الْفُضَلَاءُ * رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ'

in_urdu.name: اسید
in_urdu.meaning: اسید مطلب ہے خوشحال بہت سارے خیر کا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسید ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے خوشحال بہت سارے خیر کا۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں بھی آیا ہے اور اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا اہم مقام ہے۔ اس نام کے حامل افراد کو خوش قسمت اور مسرور سمجھا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: एस्सईद

in_hindi.long_meaning: एस्सईद एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है और इसका अर्थ है खुशहाल और बहुत सारे अच्छे भाग्य। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और इसे पवित्र कुरआन में भी उल्लेखित किया गया है। इस नाम के धारकों को भाग्यशाली और खुशहाल माना जाता है

in_pashto.name: سعيد
in_pashto.meaning: سعيد د خوښۍ او ډير خير معنا لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: سعيد يو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی او د خوښۍ او ډير خير معنا لري. دا نوم د افغانستان په اسلامي دود کې ډير اهميت لري او په قرآن کريم کې هم يادونه شوی دی. د دې نوم خاوندان خوشحاله او مزاج لرونکي ګڼل کيږي

data.cultural_impact: The name Essaeed carries a rich cultural significance, as it is derived from the Arabic language, which is the lingua franca of the Islamic world. The name's root, "said," means "praised" or "admired," which indicates a person whom others hold in high esteem. In many Islamic communities, the name Essaeed is often given to babies born into influential or respected families or to those who have shown remarkable achievements in various fields such as education, science, art, or philanthropy. The name's cultural impact lies in its association with noble character, leadership, and achievement.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Essaeed holds a deeper spiritual significance, as it is rooted in the Islamic tradition of recognizing and praising Allah's blessings and blessings bestowed upon us. When we call someone Essaeed, we are essentially acknowledging their connection to the divine and the inherent value and worth that Allah has bestowed upon them. It's a reminder that regardless of personal accomplishments or worldly success, true worth and honor come from Allah alone. Additionally, the name Essaeed can serve as a daily inspiration for its bearer to strive towards living a life worthy of praise and admiration from Allah and His creation.
